title: New Outlook for Windows app data
whyItMatters: The Store version of Outlook keeps local configuration, cached web data and attachments. It shows that the account was signed into this PC.
source: Microsoft Learn, new Outlook profile and cache locations: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-apps/outlook/get-started/virtualized-desktop-infrastructure
notes: Microsoft also documents %LOCALAPPDATA%/Microsoft/olk for cache and attachments; that is a separate folder. Mail stays on the server; no content is parsed.
